checklist.evidence: Diagnosis blames Deployment/vigil-app and its mem-load sidecar, not the ground-truth fault origin vigil-worker-1.
It identifies the application Deployment and sidecar as root cause rather than runtime sysctl drift on vigil-worker-1.
It misidentifies vigil-app's mem-load sidecar and memory configuration as the fault origin.
It describes memory-stress injection and readiness starvation, not net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables sysctl drift.
It cites stress-ng arguments and memory limits, omitting the mutated sysctl key, value 0, and restore value 1.
The diagnosis attributes the failure to an unrelated memory-pressure fault instead of runtime sysctl misconfiguration.
It blames an uninvolved mem-load sidecar, nginx memory starvation, and Deployment manifest configuration.
Across the diagnoses, both vigil-app and vigil-worker-1 are explicitly mentioned, although their fault roles are incorrect.
It describes memory pressure and readiness timeouts, whereas the ground truth states sysctl drift broke pod networking.

diagnosis_text:
Diagnosis 1:
 root_cause: The declared manifest in git injects a stress-ng `mem-load` sidecar (--vm 1 --vm-keep --vm-bytes 50M) into the vigil-app pod alongside a 128Mi memory limit on the nginx container, and the resulting pod-cgroup memory pressure stalls nginx so its /healthz readiness probe exceeds the 1s timeout, holding the Deployment permanently at readyReplicas=0. root_cause_component: Deployment/vigil-app
 recommended_action: git_commit_k8s

Diagnosis 3:
 root_cause: The declared Deployment for vigil-app schedules an unbounded memory-stress sidecar (stress-ng --vm 1 --vm-bytes 50M --vm-keep --timeout 0, limits memory 96Mi) in the same pod as the nginx container on vigil-worker-1, starving nginx so its /healthz proxy_pass to app-backend times out and the readiness probe never passes; app-backend itself answers /healthz with HTTP 200 in microseconds, and the node is Ready with no taints or pressure. root_cause_component: Deployment/vigil-app (mem-load sidecar, ghcr.io/colinianking/stress-ng, --timeout 0)
 recommended_action: git_commit_k8s
